name: hackintosh-skills
description: 黑苹果（OpenCore）EFI 配置审查与维护：BIOS 审查、配置校验、日志取证、驱动安装、系统升级、选择器主题、换机型与三码。
description_en: Hackintosh (OpenCore) EFI configuration audit & maintenance: BIOS audit, config verification, log forensics, driver installs, OS upgrades, boot-picker theming, SMBIOS switching and board serials.

plugins.name: opencore-config-audit
plugins.description: 审查、修改与维护黑苹果的 OpenCore EFI 配置与驱动安装：BIOS/UEFI 审查、逐键对照官方文档、ACPI/SSDT 巡检（官方 AcpiSamples + 5T33Z0/OC-Little-Translated 热补丁样例库）、kext 精简、更新 kext 与 OpenCore（厂商钉死 vs Dortania build-repo 构建）、引导日志与启动耗时取证、装不上/进不去系统的分层 debug 流程、系统大版本升级（含网卡 kext 的 MinKernel/MaxKernel 版本分流）、磁盘屏蔽，以及 NVIDIA / Intel 无线 / MediaTek（macOS 26 原生 Sunrise + MT7922 Sunrise Pack 打包方案 + SimpleMtkWlan fork）/ 博通网卡、AppleALC 声卡（含 macOS 26 的 AppleHDA 恢复；定制 layout 走 5T33Z0/AppleALC-Guides）、HiDPI、Intel 睿频（★ 最佳 DataProvider 定案）、开小核/关小核（E 核）、AMFI 关闭导致的 TCC 权限失效（tcc-helper）、CPU 显示名（revcpuname）、内存定制、SMBIOS 三码等驱动与硬件特性，以及启动界面外观（OpenCanopy 主题：图标集、PickerAttributes、Flavour、标签/字体/音频/背景）与 **SMBIOS 机型切换/三码**（★ 先完善 SSDT → 再换机型 → 再重做 CPUFriend；含主板 OEM SSDT 与 AE_NOT_FOUND 根因）。
plugins.description_en: Audit, edit and maintain a hackintosh OpenCore EFI configuration and its driver installs: BIOS/UEFI settings audit, per-key verification against the official docs, ACPI/SSDT review against the official AcpiSamples and the 5T33Z0/OC-Little-Translated hotpatch library, kext trimming, deciding whether to update kexts/OpenCore, boot-log and boot-timeline forensics, layered debugging when macOS won't boot, major macOS upgrade planning (including per-Darwin-version kext gating with MinKernel/MaxKernel), disk masking, plus NVIDIA / Intel WiFi / MediaTek (native Sunrise + MT7922 Sunrise Pack + SimpleMtkWlan fork) / Broadcom cards, AppleALC audio (incl. restoring AppleHDA on macOS 26; custom layouts via 5T33Z0/AppleALC-Guides), HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost (best-practice CPUFriend data), E-core enable/disable, TCC permission recovery when AMFI is disabled (tcc-helper), CPU display-name override, memory injection SMBIOS/serials, OpenCanopy boot-picker theming, and SMBIOS model switching with board serials (finish SSDT first, then SMBIOS, then CPUFriend).
